name: Witch Doctor: ranged-slot cast times and their haste path
contract: Reclamation ranks, Spirit Volley and the Spirit Glaive ladder are ranged-slot spells (SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT,
Attributes 0x00050012 / 0x00050010) whose own SpellCastTimes entry is 1800 ms (Reclamation, Spirit Volley) and
2000 ms (Spirit Glaive). The 3.3.5 client's cast-time routine adds 500 ms for a ranged-slot spell and then scales
the result by the ranged attack-time ratio (see starcaller-ranged-shot-cast-time, which pins that routine from
Ascension.exe); SpellInfo::CalcCastTime and Unit::ModSpellCastTime do the same on the server, so Reclamation casts
in 2300 ms before haste, and Darkspear Traditionalist's 10% ranged haste takes it and Spirit Volley to 2090 ms
(2300 / 1.1, measured below). Spirit Glaive additionally carries the Witch Doctor agility clause in
Unit::ModSpellCastTime (family 19, flags 0x02000000), so it lands below 2500 ms at any agility. Nothing in the
shipped data or in either cast-time path is 500 ms short of the client, which is what #6973 has to be answered
with. Spells that carry no cast-time entry at all keep returning 0 and are unaffected.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Reclamation rank 8 is its 1800 ms entry plus the client's 500 ms ranged preparation
Spirit Glaive is its 2000 ms entry plus 500 ms, minus the Witch Doctor agility clause
Voodoo Arrow is its own 500 ms entry plus 500 ms
Darkspear's ranged haste lowers the Reclamation cast (2300 / 1.1)
The same haste lowers Spirit Volley
